approach: Replace the trailer rule in land::pr_commits with content classification. For each commit in remote_base..head (oldest first) build Change::of_commit and Judged::new from athena-gate, then: (1) closing_jobs (made pub, logic unchanged) non-empty → job_landing, requiring exactly one job, a verification record and a landed outcome in the commit's tree; (2) else an added records/interventions/<month>/<id>.json with valid id and matching month → declared_intervention; (3) else tree fingerprint under the parent's rules equals the parent's → records_only; (4) else error naming the sha. PrCommit gains kind and optional job/verification; gh.rs GitLandingRecords::commits copies them into LandingCommit. Fixtures in gh.rs, reconcile.rs and the CLI reconcile test follow the content rules. drain.rs (crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs) and run.rs are audited; expected no code change.

decisions.choice: Make athena_gate::invariant::closing_jobs pub and call it per commit.
decisions.reason: Single source of truth for closing records, including blocked-job exclusion, so blocked-then-landed needs no new logic.

rejected.option: Re-implement the closing-path scan in land.rs

rejected.why: It re-checks ordering and fingerprints already checked at commit time.

decisions.choice: Non-empty closing_jobs means job_landing; several jobs, missing verification, or non-landed outcome is an error naming the sha. The pr_commits doc and records-history.md state that a commit closing several jobs (a squashed chain, which closing_jobs/landing_job allow) is refused as a known limit because LandingCommit carries one job.
decisions.reason: Unverifiable or multi-job landings must not be recorded silently.

rejected.option: Require a fingerprint change for job_landing
rejected.why: Empty-change landed job would be lost.

decisions.choice: Verification id from verification_id(job, sha) after confirming JobFiles.verification exists in the commit's tree.
decisions.reason: Works when verification came from an earlier commit.

rejected.option: Require verification in the same commit

decisions.choice: Recognise declared intervention by an added records/interventions/<month>/<id>.json path; no trailer reads.
decisions.reason: Content-based, same path rule as the gate.

rejected.why: Request is to stop reading trailers.

decisions.choice: records_only is judged by the parent's rules; doc comment says a .gitattributes added in the same commit as an owner-path file does not exclude it. Add one refusal assertion for that case naming the sha.
decisions.reason: Matches how the gate fingerprints a change and makes the choice visible.

rejected.why: A commit could exclude its own governed change.

decisions.choice: Fix fixtures (shared cfg(test) pub(crate) helper in land.rs for core; CLI test uses a records-only owner-notes commit with nested .gitattributes in base) rather than loosen code.
decisions.reason: Code is right to refuse trailer-only commits.

decisions.choice: Audit crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs and run.rs retry_landing; no code change expected. drain.rs depends on pr_commits indirectly: PrLander::land (drain.rs ~1263) → Athena::land_pr → GitLandingRecords::for_remote (gh.rs ~1987) → commits() (gh.rs ~1422) → pr_commits. It only reads PrReport. Covering test is the gh.rs land_pr tests using GitLandingRecords; tests/external_calls.rs reaches land_pr with records: None and never calls pr_commits. retry_landing writes commits and does not call pr_commits.
decisions.reason: They consume results, not trailers; verify by grep before leaving unchanged.

rejected.why: No dependence on the changed contract; keeps change small.
The real drain.rs is in athena-cli; no new file is needed.

files.purpose: Make closing_jobs pub with doc noting it is shared with athena-core pr_commits.
Content-based PrCommit/pr_commits, docs, fixture helper, new tests, remove trailer-count tests.
GitLandingRecords::commits copies kind/job/verification; update land_pr fixtures and docs; add records-only test.
Test World::pr_head commits a real landed job.
PR commit becomes records-only owner-notes commit with nested exclusion in base.
Audit PrLander::land path; expected no change (listed deliverable path is crates/athena-core/src/drain.rs, which does not exist).
Describe content-based classification, multi-job limit and parent-rules exclusion; remove trailer rule.

steps: Make closing_jobs pub in invariant.rs with updated doc; confirm JobFiles, Change, Judged are reachable from athena-core.

Rewrite PrCommit {sha, tree, kind, job, verification} and pr_commits in land.rs per the content rules; errors name sha, base, head; empty range stays an error; doc comments state content rules, parent-rules exclusion, the multi-job squash refusal and closing_jobs as single source; no trailer reads.
Delete trailer-count tests; add fixture helper and tests: realistic range, blocked-then-landed, refusals (including same-commit .gitattributes), empty range.
Update gh.rs GitLandingRecords::commits, job_ids, docs, land_pr fixtures; add records-only test.
Update reconcile.rs World::pr_head to commit a landed job via the helper.
Update CLI reconcile test: owner-notes/.gitattributes in base, PR commit adds an owner-notes file, no trailer.

Audit crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs (PrLander::land → land_pr → GitLandingRecords::commits → pr_commits), tests/external_calls.rs and run.rs retry_landing by grep; change nothing unless they read trailers or call pr_commits directly.

Run cargo test -p athena-core land::, gh::, full core, cli reconcile, cargo test --locked, clippy, fmt; write change description listing callers/writers with covering tests, fixtures vs code, and commands run.

risks.risk: Fixture records that do not parse or sit off canonical paths are silently dropped by JobFiles::load.
risks.mitigation: Use well-formed records from gate landing_tests constructors, build paths from JobId::dir(), assert JobFiles::load finds the job.

risks.risk: closing_jobs requires exact path and status 'A'.
risks.mitigation: Blocked-then-landed test proves it works from outcome-landed.json alone.

risks.risk: Boundary scan bans a word a doc comment might contain.
risks.mitigation: Use owner-notes and describe the pattern without the banned word; run full cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: Other tests reaching pr_commits via land_pr still use trailer-only commits.
risks.mitigation: Grep pr_commits and GitLandingRecords; run the whole suite.

demonstrations.method: Unit test: base commits nested owner-notes/.gitattributes '* athena-exclude'; then reading, dispatch, introspection, owner-notes file, intervention record, then job candidate/verification/outcome plus governed work; no trailers; call pr_commits.
demonstrations.observes: Kinds are [RecordsOnly x4, DeclaredIntervention, JobLanding]; last carries the fixture job and verification id.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the trailer rule every commit errors; wrong classification changes the asserted kinds.

demonstrations.method: Unit test: commit 1 adds candidate, verification, blocked outcome; commit 2 adds only outcome-landed.json plus a governed file.
demonstrations.observes: Commit 1 RecordsOnly with no job; commit 2 JobLanding for that job with its verification id.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without reusing closing_jobs the blocked commit is mis-classified or the outcome-landed-only commit does not map to its job.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests: governed change with no intervention/closing records; landing without verification; landed outcome absent (blocked outcome only with landing path); owner-path file without exclusion (including same-commit .gitattributes case).
demonstrations.observes: Each pr_commits Err text contains the offending commit sha.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the refusals these commits classify as records or landings and no error contains the sha.

demonstrations.method: Run the full core suite then the CLI reconcile tests.
demonstrations.observes: All pass including the 5 core reconcile tests; then `cargo test -p athena-cli --test reconcile` passes the 2 CLI tests; description says fixtures changed and why.
demonstrations.fails_without: Trailer-only fixtures fail pr_commits, so those 7 tests fail unless fixtures carry real closing records or a records-only commit.

demonstrations.method: land_pr tests with a real landed-job commit and a records-only commit; assert landing.commits kind/job/verification and validate().unwrap().
demonstrations.observes: LandingCommits match pr_commits output; validate passes; intent.job_ids lists only job_landing jobs.
demonstrations.fails_without: If kind/job/verification were not copied, records-only commits would become JobLanding and fail validate.

demonstrations.method: Trailerless tests plus pr_commits(base, base) asserting Err containing 'adds no commit'; read land.rs and confirm no trailers()/Athena-Job in pr_commits/PrCommit and doc comments state content rules and closing_jobs as single source; old trailer-count tests removed.
demonstrations.observes: Empty-range error; trailerless tests pass; docs as stated.
demonstrations.fails_without: A leftover trailer read makes trailerless tests error; dropping the empty-range error fails its test.

demonstrations.method: Compare the change description with grep-found callers and writers: gh.rs GitLandingRecords::commits/intent/landing/write_landing, reconcile.rs via GitLandingRecords, crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs PrLander::land (indirect, gh.rs land_pr tests), tests/external_calls.rs (records: None, never reaches pr_commits), run.rs retry_landing (writer, no pr_commits call), CLI reconcile tests; cited commands actually run.
demonstrations.observes: Every caller/writer listed with its covering test and commands run with results.

demonstrations.method: Read diffs of docs/design/records-history.md and CHANGELOG.md.
demonstrations.observes: Content-based classification and closing_jobs described, the multi-job squash refusal and parent-rules exclusion stated; the exactly-one-Athena-Job-trailer rule is gone; CHANGELOG entry under unreleased.

demonstrations.method: Run clippy, then fmt exactly as the criterion states.
demonstrations.observes: Clean; then `cargo fmt --check` clean (also the check form `cargo fmt --all --check`).
demonstrations.fails_without: A lint in new code (unused import after trailer removal, needless clone) or unformatted code makes the command exit non-zero.
